Student grade & study guides

Understand your gradebook, make sense of GPA and turn assessment targets into practical study plans.

Start with the question you need to answer.

A number is useful only when the method fits your course. These guides work through common gradebook problems, explain which records to include and show how to check the result. Each new guide includes a numerical example, clear limitations and links to a calculator you can use next.

Choose grade calculations for points and weighting, GPA and assessment for transcript and scoring questions, or study planning for attendance, reading and exam preparation. Examples use stated assumptions rather than a universal grading policy. Your syllabus and institution determine your official outcome.
